flow: Generate with AI → Evaluation Context → Generate and Evaluate → Confirm
purpose: Baseline full generation flow with complete context, a legitimate-looking sender/link, and an attachment.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis uses an internal document portal. Finance staff review reconciliation documents during quarter-end close.
generation_context.sender_context: Internal IT Service Desk supporting the document portal.
generation_context.additional_instructions: Keep the message realistic and concise.

evaluation_context.situation_context: The finance team is currently completing quarter-end reconciliation and expects document review requests.

steps: Open New Template and click Generate with AI.
Fill Generation Parameters exactly as shown in case.json.
Continue to Evaluation Context and select Windropolis | IT Desk.
Fill the expected sender, situation, link fields, and upload Q3_Reconciliation.txt.
Inspect the result and click Confirm.
expected_invariants: Request completes without an HTTP/UI error.
Evaluation Context is shown as complete or has no unexpected missing fields.
The legitimate-looking corporate sender/link are not automatically treated as lookalike spoofing.
Confirm copies Subject/Text/HTML into the main template editor.
